# Persona

Persona offers identity infrastructure that allows you to craft personalized and automated verification solutions so you can better understand & protect users.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/persona/.

## Actions

- **Create an Account**: Create an account in Persona.
- **Create Webhook**: Create a new webhook in Persona.
- **List All Accounts** (read-only): List all accounts in Persona.
- **List All Cases** (read-only): List all cases in Persona.
- **List all Events** (read-only): List all events from Persona.
- **List All Inquiries** (read-only): List all inquiries in Persona.
- **List All Lists** (read-only): List all lists in Persona.
- **List All Reports** (read-only): List all reports in Persona.
- **List All Transactions** (read-only): List all transactions in Persona.
- **List All Webhooks** (read-only): List all webhooks in Persona.
- **Retrieve a Document** (read-only): Retrieve a document from Persona.
- **Retrieve an Account** (read-only): Retrieve an account in Persona.
- **Search Accounts** (read-only): Search accounts in Persona using flexible query criteria.
- **Search Cases** (read-only): Search cases in Persona using advanced query filters with boolean logic.
- **Update a Webhook**: Update a webhook in Persona.
- **Update an Account**: Update an account in Persona.
- **Add Tag to Account**: Add a tag to an Account in Persona.
